catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class observes a MAVROS mavros_msgs/PositionTarget target topic. The motion classes are commands, not an observation of the MAVROS local target, so an extension read with an inline target_x/target_y/target_z schema is used.

No catalogue class observes a MAVROS geometry_msgs/PoseStamped local-position topic. cap.motion.cartesian_pose.v1 is a robot.arm command in millimetres with an inverse-kinematics reached output, not a MAVROS local-pose observation, so an extension read with an inline position schema is used.

No catalogue class publishes a MAVROS geometry_msgs/PoseStamped local position setpoint. cap.motion.mobile_base.v1 is a bounded linear/angular velocity command with distance/heading outputs; cap.motion.cartesian_pose.v1 is robot.arm-only in millimetres. The receipt reports published, confirmed and the sent_x, sent_y and sent_z values handed to rosbridge, so an extension invoke is used.
